Za Ndani.name: Za Ndani
Za Ndani.bio: The Za Ndani newsroom desk brings together breaking updates, public-interest reporting and explainers across Kenya. Desk bylines are used for stories prepared or reviewed as newsroom coverage rather than assigned to a single specialist section.

Jonathan Mwaniki.name: Jonathan Mwaniki
Jonathan Mwaniki.bio: Oversees Za Ndani’s editorial direction and publishing priorities, with a focus on clear reporting, useful context and a strong connection to the issues shaping Kenya’s public conversation.

Celestine Nzioka.name: Celestine Nzioka
Celestine Nzioka.bio: Covers national developments, public institutions and governance. The reporting focus is on what decisions mean for citizens, how public services are affected and what readers need to know next.

Mutheu Ann.name: Mutheu Ann
Mutheu Ann.bio: Tracks Kenya’s entertainment industry, music releases, celebrity developments and the business behind popular culture. Coverage puts public statements and confirmed developments ahead of online speculation.

Martin Mutwiri.name: Martin Mutwiri
Martin Mutwiri.bio: Follows performers, screen culture, live events and the changing business of entertainment in Kenya. Stories connect headline moments with the wider context behind the industry.

Timothy Muli.name: Timothy Muli
Timothy Muli.bio: Covers farming, food systems, rural livelihoods and environmental issues. The focus is on practical consequences for producers, households and communities beyond major towns.

Amara Ndlovu.name: Amara Ndlovu
Amara Ndlovu.bio: Explores music, film, creative industries and cultural movements across Africa, connecting regional stories with the people, audiences and ideas shaping them.

Elizabeth Muthoni.name: Elizabeth Muthoni
Elizabeth Muthoni.bio: Follows technology, digital services, online safety and policy changes affecting people and businesses in Kenya. Coverage explains both the innovation and the real-world implications.

Grace Mkamburi.name: Grace Mkamburi
Grace Mkamburi.bio: Reports on companies, markets, entrepreneurship and economic policy. Stories look beyond announcements to explain the commercial decisions, consumer effects and wider economic context.

Ann Mwende.name: Ann Mwende
Ann Mwende.bio: Covers everyday life, culture, wellbeing, travel and changing social trends in Kenya. The emphasis is on useful information, relatable experiences and the context behind lifestyle conversations.

Kendi Kawira.name: Kendi Kawira
Kendi Kawira.bio: Develops people-centred features and community stories from across Kenya, highlighting local perspectives, emerging issues and the details that can be missed in fast-moving headlines.

Okwonko Ben.name: Okwonko Ben
Okwonko Ben.bio: Covers the overlap between public affairs, popular culture and the personalities shaping national conversations. The approach pairs accessible storytelling with context and careful attribution.

The Scoop KE.name: The Scoop KE
The Scoop KE.bio: A Za Ndani desk byline for concise entertainment updates, industry announcements and developing showbiz stories. Coverage prioritises clear attribution and the latest confirmed details.

The Scoop Kenya.name: The Scoop Kenya
The Scoop Kenya.bio: A Za Ndani desk byline focused on Kenyan showbiz, celebrity culture and entertainment developments. Stories are presented with the available context and a clear distinction between confirmed information and claims.

Wanjiku Kuria.name: Wanjiku Kuria
Wanjiku Kuria.bio: Follows public figures, national developments and stories moving through Kenya’s civic conversation. Coverage aims to separate verified developments from reaction and explain why an issue matters to readers.

Martin Kihara.name: Martin Kihara
Martin Kihara.bio: Covers music, performers, screen culture and the business of entertainment across Kenya and the region. Reporting follows the people and decisions behind the headlines, not just the viral moment.

Jaj.name: Jaj
Jaj.bio: Publishes commentary on public affairs, policy and the issues shaping everyday life. The opinion desk makes its argument explicit, distinguishes analysis from straight news and grounds its perspective in the available facts.
